`App` is the entry point and root orchestrator for the frontend subsystem — it composes the global notification context and the application routing tree to produce the final React component hierarchy.
`main.tsx` is the primary entry point for the frontend subsystem — it initializes the React root, injects the global Material UI theme, and mounts the `App` component into the DOM.

`frontend/src/features/admin/index.ts` serves as the public entry point into the admin subsystem, aggregating and exposing core page components, UI controls, and administrative logic hooks for consumption by the broader application.

`frontend/src/features/analytics/index.ts` serves as the public entry point for the analytics subsystem, aggregating and exposing feature-specific components for consumption by the broader application.

`TagCoOccurrenceGrid` is the orchestrator for the analytics visualization pipeline — it sequences state management for axis configuration, asynchronous tag data fetching, and the rendering of a responsive heatmap matrix.
`index.ts` serves as the public entry point for the `TagCoOccurrenceGrid` subsystem, exposing the component and its associated type definitions to the rest of the analytics feature set.

`SearchResults` is the presentation orchestrator for the library search interface — it consumes grouped search data and dispatches navigation events to the `LibraryBrowser` while managing the UI state for collapsible result categories.

`frontend/src/features/calibration/index.ts` is the public entry point for the calibration subsystem, exposing core UI components, hooks, and data types for consumption by the broader application. This module acts as a facade, consolidating the feature's internal implementation details into a unified API surface.

`frontend/src/features/config/index.ts` acts as the public entry point for the configuration subsystem, aggregating and re-exporting core components and hooks for consumption by the broader application.

`ConfigField` is the presentation component for the configuration management system — it acts as a polymorphic factory that maps configuration keys to specific MUI input controls based on metadata definitions.

MLInference is the configuration UI orchestrator for machine learning models — it consumes model state from the `useMLModels` hook to render VRAM management controls and an interactive table for per-model output label editing.
`index.ts` serves as the public entry point for the insights feature subsystem, exposing the `InsightsPage` component for consumption by the application router and feature-level orchestrators.

`frontend/src/features/library/index.ts` serves as the public entry point for the library subsystem, aggregating and exposing core components, hooks, and types for consumption by the broader application.

`LibraryManagement` is the primary React component orchestrator for the library administration dashboard — it manages the CRUD lifecycle, scan initiation, tag-write reconciliation, and vector configuration state for the application's music libraries.

`LibraryManagement.test.tsx` is the test suite orchestrator for the library configuration and pipeline monitoring features, validating UI interactions, API integration, and state persistence for library management.

`frontend/src/features/navidrome/index.ts` acts as the primary entry point for the Navidrome feature subsystem, aggregating and exposing core components, hooks, and pages for consumption by the broader application.

`ApiSettingsPanel` is the configuration orchestrator for the Navidrome integration — it manages the lifecycle of API key generation, persistence of Subsonic connection credentials, and validation via connectivity testing.

`ruleUtils.ts` is the factory and validator for the playlist rule builder — it orchestrates the creation, recursive depth analysis, and query string serialization of hierarchical boolean rule structures.
`index.ts` is the public entry point for the playlist-import subsystem, exposing the `PlaylistImportPage` component for consumption by the application router or feature registry.

`index.ts` serves as the public entry point for the `tag-curation` feature subsystem, aggregating and exposing core page components, UI controls, and data visualization grids for external consumption.

`VectorSearchPage` is the primary UI orchestrator for the vector similarity search feature — it consumes track metadata and vector backbones to provide an interactive interface for querying similar audio files and exporting results to Navidrome.

`index.ts` is the entry point for the vector-search subsystem, acting as the public interface that exposes the `VectorSearchPage` component and the `TrackSearchPicker` utility for consumption by the broader application.

`calibration.ts` is the API client adapter for the calibration subsystem — it orchestrates asynchronous communication between the frontend and the backend calibration services by mapping HTTP endpoints to typed TypeScript interfaces.

`client.ts` is the centralized HTTP orchestrator and API gateway for the frontend — it sequences request dispatching, authentication injection, response normalization, and error handling across the entire application.
`files.ts` is the API adapter for the library file management system — it provides a structured interface for querying, batch-fetching, and filtering music library assets via the backend REST API.

`frontend/src/shared/api/library.ts` is the API client adapter for the library management domain — it bridges the frontend application to the backend REST endpoints by providing strongly-typed request dispatchers, response mappers, and state management utilities.

`frontend/src/shared/api/index.ts` serves as the central entry point and barrel file for the API subsystem, aggregating and exposing all domain-specific service functions, types, and client utilities to the frontend application.

`navidrome.ts` is the API client adapter that orchestrates communication between the frontend and the Navidrome integration layer, consuming backend endpoints to provide type-safe data access for playlist generation, tag metadata, and server status.

`vectors.ts` is the API adapter for the vector search and maintenance pipeline — it provides the interface for querying similarity indices, managing hot-to-cold data promotion, and triggering index rebuilds.

The `navidrome-plugin/Makefile` serves as the build and packaging automation tool for the Nomarr Navidrome plugin. It abstracts the complexities of compiling Go-based WebAssembly (Wasm) modules, ensuring consistent builds for the Navidrome plugin ecosystem.
`index.ts` serves as the central entry point and barrel file for the shared UI subsystem, consolidating and re-exporting reusable presentational building blocks for use across the application.

`main.go` is the entry point and orchestrator for the Nomarr plugin — it bridges Navidrome to Nomarr's ML-powered APIs by implementing the `SimilarSongsByTrackProvider`, `Scrobbler`, and `CallbackProvider` interfaces.

`analytics_comp.py` is the pure-functional computation engine for the analytics pipeline — it consumes raw tag data and file mappings to produce aggregated statistical models, correlation matrices, and mood distributions.

`Application` is the central composition root and dependency injection container for the Nomarr application, serving as the primary entry point for managing the lifecycle of all services, workers, and infrastructure components.
`nomarr/start.py` serves as the primary entry point for the Nomarr application, orchestrating the initialization of system services, worker processes, and the API server.

`library_admin_comp.py` is the administrative orchestrator for the library management lifecycle — it sequences path validation, name resolution, persistence, and pipeline state initialization for media libraries.

`path_comp.py` is the resolver and validator for the library filesystem interface — it transforms raw string paths into structured `LibraryPath` objects by verifying their relationship to configured library roots and checking disk accessibility.

`mood_analysis_comp.py` is the analytical engine for mood-based metadata — it aggregates, correlates, and calculates distribution statistics for song mood tags across strict, regular, and loose tiers.

`library_file_mutation_comp.py` is the persistence layer adapter for library-file lifecycle management — it orchestrates the creation, modification, and deletion of file documents and their associated ownership edges within the database.

`library_file_state_comp.py` is the state machine orchestrator for the library file lifecycle — it manages the transition logic, initialization, and querying of boolean state vertices within the persistence layer.

`library_records_comp.py` is the orchestrator for the library configuration lifecycle — it sequences CRUD operations, scan-state enrichment, filesystem path validation, and ML-readiness analysis for library documents.

`library_file_query_comp.py` is the query orchestrator for the library persistence layer — it sequences multi-hop database reads, tag hydration, and state filtering across the `db.library`, `db.app`, and `db.ml` sub-facades.
`metadata_extraction_comp.py` is the adapter for the audio metadata ingestion pipeline — it orchestrates format-specific tag parsing, normalization, and fingerprint generation for the library.

`scan_lifecycle_comp.py` is the persistence orchestrator for library scan state — it sequences the lifecycle of library scanning, folder-cache synchronization, and pipeline state transitions across the `db.app` and `db.library` collections.

`entity_seeding_comp.py` is the orchestrator for the metadata seeding pipeline — it sequences the extraction, normalization, and batch persistence of raw file tags into the authoritative song-tag graph.

`ml_audio_comp.py` is the audio processing adapter for the machine learning pipeline — it orchestrates the decoding, resampling, and validation of audio files into normalized `numpy` waveforms for downstream feature extraction.

`ml_preprocess_comp.py` is the preprocessing orchestrator for the audio inference pipeline — it consumes raw audio waveforms and produces structured, backbone-specific mel spectrogram patches ready for ONNX model consumption.

`ml_calibration_state_comp.py` is the persistence layer adapter for calibration state management — it encapsulates all `db.*` interactions for calibration workflows to ensure domain logic remains decoupled from database schema details.

`ml_calibration_comp.py` is the analytical engine for the model calibration pipeline — it orchestrates the computation of empirical score distributions, generates normalization parameters, and manages the persistence of calibration sidecars.

`ml_embed_comp.py` is the inference pipeline utility that orchestrates audio segmentation, model-based scoring, and statistical pooling of embedding vectors. It provides the foundational logic for transforming raw waveform data into fixed-length segments, applying arbitrary prediction functions, and aggregating multi-s…

`ml_head_pipeline_comp.py` is the parallel inference orchestrator for the ML pipeline — it manages a persistent thread pool to dispatch ONNX classification head predictions, aggregates results, and handles lifecycle teardown.

`ml_output_stream_store_comp.py` is the persistence layer orchestrator for canonical ML output streams — it sequences the normalization, upsertion, retrieval, and metadata enrichment of model inference outputs linked to library files.
`ONNXBackboneModel` is the adapter for embedding-extractor backbone models — it orchestrates the transformation of raw audio waveforms into patch-based embedding vectors via ONNX inference sessions.
`BaseONNXModel` is the abstract base orchestrator for the ONNX model lifecycle — it manages `InferenceSession` state, device placement, and automated VRAM-constrained self-healing.
`ONNXModelCache` is the orchestrator for the ML model lifecycle — it manages the discovery, lazy-loading, device-placement, and memory-eviction of backbone and head ONNX models.

`ml_discovery_comp.py` is the discovery orchestrator for the ONNX model ecosystem — it sequences filesystem traversal, database-backed label resolution, and model instantiation for backbones and inference heads.

`ONNXHeadModel` is the adapter for the ML inference pipeline — it consumes embedding vectors from backbone models, executes ONNX-based classification or regression heads, and produces per-class activation scores.

`ml_session_comp.py` is the ONNX Runtime orchestrator for the ML inference pipeline — it sequences session initialization, provider selection (CUDA/CPU), VRAM memory budgeting, and batch-processed execution.
`ml_model_registry_comp.py` is the persistence layer adapter for ML model registration — it orchestrates the mapping of ONNX model metadata and output vertices into the ArangoDB graph store.

`ml_capacity_probe_comp.py` is the orchestrator for the ML resource admission control pipeline — it sequences model set hashing, distributed database-backed locking, resource measurement (VRAM/RAM), and persistence to ensure safe worker scaling.

`ml_tier_selection_comp.py` is the deterministic resource orchestrator for the ML execution pipeline — it evaluates hardware capacity against configured budgets to resolve the optimal execution tier (0-4) for worker systems.

`ml_vram_coordinator_comp.py` is the orchestrator for the multi-worker GPU resource allocation pipeline — it sequences telemetry-based capacity checks, atomic promise registration, and lifecycle management for model VRAM reservations.

`ml_vram_probe_comp.py` is the diagnostic orchestrator for the ML resource pipeline — it sequences sequential model loading, CUDA context warming, and GPU telemetry polling to produce authoritative VRAM consumption metrics for ONNX models.

`ml_vector_maintenance_comp.py` is the maintenance orchestrator for the vector storage lifecycle — it provides utilities for runtime embedding dimension inference and batch-processing schema migrations for cold vector collections.

`ml_vector_registry_comp.py` is the registry orchestrator for the ML vector lifecycle — it resolves hot/cold/maintenance namespaces by backbone and library identifiers, and manages cross-collection batch deletion.

`descriptor_match_comp.py` is the resolver and matcher for the Navidrome integration pipeline — it sequences the transformation of raw library documents into portable descriptors and executes multi-stage heuristic matching to map external track seeds to internal Nomarr `library_files`.

`navidrome_graph_comp.py` is the persistence adapter for the Navidrome integration layer — it orchestrates graph-based storage, resolution, and playcount tracking for Navidrome entities within the ArangoDB backend.
`arango_bootstrap_comp.py` is the orchestrator for the ArangoDB schema initialization pipeline — it sequences collection creation, index provisioning, graph configuration, and state document seeding.

`playlist_builder_comp.py` is the factory orchestrator for the Navidrome personal playlist pipeline — it sequences ANN (Approximate Nearest Neighbor) vector similarity searches, taste profile filtering, and playlist assembly logic.

`SubsonicClient` is the adapter for the Navidrome communication layer — it encapsulates the Subsonic REST API protocol, handling token-based authentication, request serialization, and response parsing for library and playlist management.

`GPUHealthMonitor` is the isolated process orchestrator for the GPU availability monitoring pipeline — it sequences periodic `nvidia-smi` probing, database state persistence, and inter-process heartbeat signaling to ensure driver-level deadlocks do not propagate to the main application.
`migration_runner_comp.py` is the orchestrator for the database migration pipeline — it sequences discovery, validation, execution, and version reconciliation for schema updates.

`resource_monitor_comp.py` is the telemetry orchestrator for the platform's adaptive resource management layer — it sequences GPU capability detection, VRAM/RAM usage polling, and headroom validation against defined operational budgets.

`file_write_comp.py` is the persistence adapter for the file tag-writing workflow — it orchestrates the abstraction of database operations, ensuring that high-level workflows consume normalized file data and tag structures without direct coupling to the underlying persistence layer.
`tag_query_comp.py` is the query resolver and data aggregator for the tagging subsystem — it bridges raw database persistence with domain-level tag operations, filtering, and cross-reference lookups.

`tag_write_comp.py` is the persistence adapter for the tagging subsystem — it orchestrates the mutation of song-tag relationships, batch tag updates, and graph-based tag relinking within the library database.

`tag_stats_comp.py` is the analytical adapter for the tagging subsystem — it aggregates raw persistence-layer data into high-level statistical distributions and frequency metrics for the analytics and reporting services.

`worker_discovery_comp.py` is the orchestrator for the distributed task-claiming pipeline — it sequences file discovery, atomic claim registration, and stale claim reconciliation across the worker fleet.

`tagging_aggregation_comp.py` is the orchestrator for the mood-tagging pipeline — it consumes raw ML regression/classification outputs to produce calibrated, conflict-resolved, and tier-expanded mood tags.

`tagging_reconstruction_comp.py` is the domain-logic component for reconstructing ML inference outputs from raw segment score streams, consuming canonical persistence data to produce `HeadOutput` objects.
`nomarr/helpers/exceptions.py` is the centralized error registry for the application, defining domain-specific exceptions that facilitate cross-layer communication and standardized error propagation.

`TagWriter` is the orchestrator for the audio metadata persistence pipeline — it consumes structured tag DTOs and dispatches format-specific writing logic for MP3, MP4/M4A, and Vorbis-based containers (FLAC, OGG, Opus).

`time_helper.py` is the type-safe time abstraction layer — it provides domain-specific wrappers for wall-clock and monotonic time sources to prevent unit mixing and ensure architectural consistency across the system.

`nomarr/helpers/config_schema.py` is the central registry and schema orchestrator for the application configuration system, defining the typed structures, UI metadata, and validation logic consumed by the `ConfigService` and the web frontend.

`nomarr/helpers/tag_key_mapping.py` is the transformer and resolver for Navidrome metadata integration — it maps internal machine-learning model storage keys to user-facing display names and TOML-compliant configuration fields.

`library_dto.py` acts as the central data contract registry for the library domain, defining the structured DTOs (Data Transfer Objects) and TypedDicts that facilitate type-safe communication between the interface, service, component, and persistence layers.

`nomarr/helpers/dto/info_dto.py` acts as the central schema definition layer for system telemetry, providing immutable data transfer objects (DTOs) that structure responses for health, configuration, and work-status monitoring services.
`calibration_dto.py` acts as the central data contract registry for the calibration subsystem, defining the schema for cross-layer communication between services, workflows, and persistence layers.

`analytics_dto.py` acts as the central schema registry and data contract provider for the analytics pipeline, defining the immutable structures used to transport domain-specific metrics across service, component, and interface layers.

`nomarr/helpers/dto/ml_dto.py` acts as the central schema registry for the ML inference and calibration pipeline — it defines the immutable data contracts consumed by components, workflows, and services to facilitate cross-layer communication.

`nomarr/helpers/dto/navidrome_dto.py` is the central schema registry and data contract provider for Navidrome integration, defining the typed interfaces for playlist generation, graph-based sync results, and user taste profiles.

`playlist_import_dto.py` serves as the data transfer object (DTO) schema definition layer, providing immutable structures that encapsulate track metadata, matching status, and final conversion results for the playlist import pipeline.

`processing_dto.py` acts as the central schema registry and data contract provider for the audio processing pipeline, defining the immutable configuration and result structures shared between the `ConfigService`, worker subprocesses, and file processing workflows.
`nomarr/interfaces/api/auth.py` is the authentication adapter for the FastAPI application, serving as the bridge between HTTP request handlers and the `KeyManagementService` infrastructure layer.

`tags_dto.py` is the data transfer object (DTO) factory and container for the tagging system — it standardizes tag representation across the persistence layer, file processing components, and workflow orchestrators.

`nomarr/interfaces/api/api_app.py` is the FastAPI entry point and orchestrator for the Nomarr service, responsible for initializing the application instance, routing traffic between integration and web realms, and managing SPA lifecycle assets.

`info_types.py` is the schema adapter for the system information and health monitoring API — it defines the Pydantic models that serialize internal Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) into structured JSON responses for external consumers.
`metadata_types.py` is the schema adapter for the API layer — it defines Pydantic models that transform internal Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) into public-facing JSON responses.
`analytics_types.py` is the adapter layer for the Analytics API — it defines Pydantic request and response models that bridge the gap between internal domain DTOs and external JSON API contracts.

`library_types.py` is the interface-layer contract definition module that produces Pydantic models for REST API request/response serialization and consumes internal Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) for transformation.
`navidrome_types.py` is the adapter layer for the Navidrome integration — it defines Pydantic request and response schemas that bridge the internal DTO domain and the external REST API contract.

`playlist_import_types.py` is the schema adapter for the playlist conversion API — it defines the Pydantic request/response contracts and provides factory methods to transform internal domain DTOs into serialized API payloads.

`navidrome_v1_if.py` is the API controller and request dispatcher for the Navidrome v1 integration layer — it maps external plugin HTTP requests to internal service workflows for similarity search, scrobbling, and playlist generation.
`nomarr/interfaces/api/web/dependencies.py` is the dependency injection provider for the FastAPI web layer, acting as a service resolver that bridges the application container to API endpoints.

`nomarr/interfaces/api/web/library_if.py` is the RESTful API controller and request dispatcher for library management — it orchestrates CRUD operations, vector configuration, and pipeline state synchronization for the web interface.

`calibration_if.py` is the API controller and web interface entry point for the calibration management pipeline — it exposes REST endpoints to orchestrate histogram generation, background tagging application, and state monitoring.

`library_scan_if.py` is the API controller and entry point for the web UI, mediating requests between the frontend and the library management, tagging, and pipeline services. It exposes RESTful endpoints for triggering library scans, reconciling file paths, managing tag write operations, and monitoring pipeline status.

`library_files_if.py` is the API controller and request dispatcher for the library management subsystem — it exposes FastAPI endpoints to bridge web client requests with `LibraryService` and `TaggingService` domain logic.

`tag_curation_if.py` is the RESTful API controller for the tag curation pipeline — it acts as the entry point for web-based tag management, bridging HTTP requests to the `TaggingService` domain logic.

`navidrome_if.py` is the API controller and request dispatcher for the Navidrome integration layer — it exposes FastAPI endpoints that bridge web UI requests to the `NavidromeService` for configuration, playlist generation, and media synchronization.

`nomarr/interfaces/api/web/vectors_if.py` is the API controller for the vector search and maintenance pipeline — it orchestrates the exposure of ANN search, index lifecycle management, and hot/cold storage statistics via FastAPI endpoints.

`cli_ui.py` is the UI adapter for the CLI interface — it encapsulates the `rich` library to provide standardized terminal rendering, status spinners, and formatted messaging across all command-line operations.

`V023_library_pipeline_states.py` is the migration orchestrator for the ArangoDB schema — it initializes the pipeline state graph, defines edge relationships between libraries and their operational states, and performs a data-migration pass to seed initial states based on file processing metrics.
`arango_client.py` is the central persistence layer factory and database adapter that orchestrates secure AQL execution by providing a sanitized, type-safe interface for the Nomarr application.

`Database` is the central persistence layer orchestrator for the Nomarr application — it sequences ArangoDB connection management, schema versioning, and domain-specific AQL operation facades to serve as the system's single source of truth.

`VectorCollection` is the persistence layer orchestrator for vector-based document storage — it provides a runtime-bound namespace for managing ArangoDB collections, abstracting AQL execution, schema validation, and edge-based relationship mapping.
`LibraryDb` is the primary persistence facade for the library domain — it orchestrates library, file, tag, and scan operations by delegating to specialized AQL operation classes.

`AppDb` is the persistence sub-facade orchestrator for application-state, locks, claims, configuration, and administrative helpers — it aggregates specialized AQL operation modules into a unified domain-intent API.

`MlDb` is the persistence sub-facade for ML model, stream, and vector operations — it orchestrates data access by delegating to specialized AQL operation classes while exposing a normalized, intent-driven API for routine application logic.

`FileStatesAqlOperations` is the persistence layer adapter for file-state graph management — it consumes `SafeDatabase` to execute AQL queries that transition, query, and bootstrap state-edge relationships between library files and state vertices.
`MlStreamsAqlOperations` is the persistence layer adapter for ML output streams — it manages the AQL-based CRUD operations, edge relationships, and document lifecycle for stream data within ArangoDB.

`nomarr/persistence/aql/primitives.py` is the low-level AQL primitive factory that consumes `SafeDatabase` connections to produce validated, parameterized query execution helpers for the persistence layer.

`AppAqlOperations` is the persistence layer adapter for the application domain — it provides high-level, domain-specific bindings that encapsulate raw AQL queries into structured CRUD operations for ArangoDB collections.

`LibrariesAqlOperations` is the persistence layer adapter for the `libraries` collection — it orchestrates CRUD operations and complex multi-collection graph teardown sequences within the ArangoDB database.

`ScanAqlOperations` is the persistence layer adapter for the `library_scans` collection — it mediates between high-level application logic and low-level AQL primitives to manage scan lifecycle records.
`MlModelsAqlOperations` is the persistence layer orchestrator for ML model metadata, providing an AQL-based interface to manage models, their outputs, and calibration states within ArangoDB.

`LibraryFilesAqlOperations` is the persistence layer orchestrator for library file management — it sequences AQL-based CRUD, reconciliation, and graph-edge maintenance for files, folders, and their associated library ownership.

`NavidromeAqlOperations` is the persistence layer adapter for Navidrome track mapping records — it orchestrates AQL-based CRUD, graph edge resolution, and playcount aggregation within the ArangoDB backend.

`TagsAqlOperations` is the persistence layer orchestrator for the tag-management subsystem — it sequences AQL-based CRUD operations, graph traversals between files and tags, and orphaned document cleanup.

`VectorsAqlOperations` is the persistence layer orchestrator for the vector indexing pipeline — it sequences the lifecycle management, AQL-based CRUD operations, and ANN index maintenance for ArangoDB vector collections.

`Popper-BWCJ2iVJ.js` is the orchestrator for the UI positioning engine — it sequences geometry calculation, collision detection, and DOM style synchronization to anchor floating elements relative to reference nodes.
`Select-7h2gWI9m.js` is the UI component factory for Material-UI (MUI) select and input primitives, serving as the bridge between raw HTML form elements and the application's design system.

`index-h13BcWK-.js` is the central entry point and runtime orchestrator for the `nomarr` frontend application — it bundles the React core, provides the dependency mapping infrastructure, and initializes the application's global style and state management systems.

`NavidromeService` is the domain-layer facade for the Navidrome integration pipeline — it orchestrates configuration generation, playlist management, scrobble ingestion, and vector-based recommendation workflows while abstracting the underlying database and API client dependencies.

`AnalyticsService` is the orchestrator for the domain-level analytics pipeline — it sequences data retrieval from the persistence layer, delegates complex computations to the analytics engine, and maps raw results into API-ready DTOs.

`MetadataService` is the domain-layer orchestrator for tag-based entity navigation — it consumes the `Database` persistence layer to map unified tag collections into structured entity relationships for artists, albums, labels, genres, and years.

`VectorMaintenanceService` is the orchestrator for the vector indexing lifecycle — it sequences the promotion of hot vectors to cold storage, triggers index rebuilds, and provides monitoring statistics for ML backbones.

`CalibrationService` is the orchestrator for the ML calibration pipeline — it sequences background task execution, state management, and reconciliation logic by delegating domain-specific histogram generation to the `calibration_generation` workflow.

`VectorSearchService` is the domain-level orchestrator for similarity search operations — it sequences library resolution, vector retrieval, and approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) execution across cold storage collections.
`LibraryScanMixin` is the orchestrator for the library scanning lifecycle — it sequences workflow dispatching, background task management, scan status aggregation, and tag validation.

`LibraryAdminMixin` is the administrative orchestrator for the library management domain — it sequences CRUD operations, vector collection provisioning, and configuration inheritance for filesystem-based media libraries.

`LibraryService` is the domain orchestrator for the library management pipeline — it aggregates CRUD, scanning, querying, and file-system reconciliation logic through a composition of specialized mixins.

`LibraryFilesMixin` is the service-layer orchestrator for library file lifecycle management — it sequences path validation, database reconciliation, tag state synchronization, and error recovery workflows.

`LibraryQueryMixin` is the primary query orchestrator for the library domain — it aggregates data from specialized library components to provide a unified interface for file discovery, tag analysis, and system status reporting.
`TaggingService` is the orchestrator for the domain-level tagging pipeline — it aggregates mixins for querying, curating, applying, and writing calibrated metadata to library files.

`TaggingApplyMixin` is the orchestrator for the calibration application lifecycle — it sequences background task management, progress tracking, and workflow delegation for applying mood tagging updates to library files.

`TaggingWriteMixin` is the orchestrator for the file-tagging reconciliation pipeline — it sequences file state claims, workflow-driven I/O operations, and background task management to ensure audio file metadata remains synchronized with library projection states.

`ConfigService` is the centralized configuration orchestrator for the `nomarr` application — it sequences the multi-layered bootstrap process, manages the in-memory cache, and handles persistence synchronization between the application state and the database.

`TaggingQueryMixin` is the query-side orchestrator for the tagging domain — it aggregates data access components to provide a unified interface for tag discovery, file-tag association, and pending write management.

`BackgroundTaskService` is the orchestrator for the asynchronous execution pipeline — it manages thread-based task lifecycle, state tracking, and memory-constrained result eviction for long-running operations.

`WorkerSystemService` is the orchestrator for the discovery-worker lifecycle — it sequences admission control, resource-aware tier selection, process spawning, health monitoring, and automated restart recovery.

`DiscoveryWorker` is the orchestrator for the ML-based file tagging pipeline — it sequences file claim acquisition, ONNX model inference, resource-constrained processing, and asynchronous persistence of metadata.
`MLService` is the facade orchestrator for the machine learning infrastructure — it sequences model discovery, registry management, and VRAM resource metadata for the application.

`InfoService` is the orchestrator for the system information pipeline — it aggregates infrastructure state, manages the `GPUHealthMonitor` lifecycle, and provides consolidated telemetry for API endpoints.
`LibraryPipelineService` is the orchestrator for the library processing pipeline — it sequences state recovery, ML calibration, tag application, and file writeback across background tasks.

`FileWatcherService` is the orchestrator for the library synchronization pipeline — it sequences filesystem event monitoring, debouncing, and library scan dispatching to ensure the domain state remains consistent with the underlying storage.

`HealthMonitorService` is the orchestrator for the system-wide health monitoring pipeline — it sequences pipe polling, deadline enforcement, status state-machine transitions, and lifecycle callback dispatching for all registered components.

`KeyManagementService` is the centralized security orchestrator for the authentication pipeline — it sequences credential lifecycle management, secure password hashing, and session state persistence across memory and database layers.

`TagExtractionWorker` is the background orchestrator for the library metadata pipeline — it sequences file claim management, audio tag extraction, graph entity seeding, and state transitions for the `nomarr` library.

`write_calibrated_tags_wf` is the orchestrator for the database-only tag update pipeline — it sequences library lookup, raw stream reconstruction, calibration application, and persistent tag aggregation.

`apply_calibration_wf` is the orchestrator for the library calibration pipeline — it sequences invariant data discovery, concurrent file-system I/O, and batched persistence to apply ML-derived tags across a library.

`generate_calibration_wf.py` is the orchestrator for the ML model calibration pipeline — it sequences model discovery, histogram-based statistical analysis, drift metric computation, and persistence of calibration state to the database.

`scan_library_quick_workflow` is the orchestrator for the incremental library indexing pipeline — it sequences folder-level cache validation, disk traversal, database synchronization, and state transitions to minimize I/O overhead.
`scan_library_full_workflow` is the orchestrator for the library synchronization pipeline — it sequences full-disk traversal, database reconciliation, state transitions, and entity cleanup.

`find_similar_tracks_wf.py` is the orchestrator for the vector-based recommendation pipeline — it sequences seed resolution, cold-collection ANN search, and metadata enrichment to produce portable track recommendations.

`parse_smart_playlist_query_wf.py` is the recursive descent parser for the Smart Playlist domain-specific language — it consumes raw query strings and produces structured `SmartPlaylistFilter` objects for downstream filtering logic.

`prepare_database_wf.py` is the orchestrator for the platform initialization pipeline — it sequences schema bootstrapping, migration execution, template collection discovery, orphan pruning, and ML model registration.

`sync_navidrome_wf.py` is the orchestrator for the Navidrome-to-Nomarr synchronization pipeline — it sequences Subsonic API traversal, path resolution, graph vertex/edge upserts, and orphan cleanup to maintain a synchronized music inventory.

`process_file_workflow` is the orchestrator for the ML tagging pipeline — it sequences path validation, audio loading, backbone embedding computation, parallel head inference, mood aggregation, and database persistence.
`convert_playlist_wf.py` is the orchestrator for the playlist import pipeline — it sequences URL parsing, streaming API fetching, local library matching, and M3U file generation.

`scripts/consolidate_migrations.py` is the administrative orchestrator for the database migration lifecycle — it sequences the deletion of legacy migration files, the generation of a new baseline migration, and the reset of database schema versioning.

`scripts/consolidate_migrations/__main__.py` is the CLI entry point and orchestrator for the migration consolidation pipeline — it sequences schema parsing, migration replaying, graph analysis, and persistence layer resets.

`consolidator.py` is the generator and orchestrator for the migration consolidation pipeline — it produces the `V001_baseline.py` migration, generates database reset AQL, and manages the deletion of legacy migration files.

`ensure_schema_parser.py` is the AST parser for the migration consolidation pipeline — it consumes the `arango_bootstrap_comp.py` source file to produce a `SchemaShape` object representing the database structure without executing application code.
`schema_model.py` is the immutable data model factory for the ArangoDB schema migration pipeline, defining the structural primitives used to represent, compare, and persist database schema states.

`ast_helpers.py` is the functional resolver for the migration AST traversal pipeline — it provides pure transformation utilities that map abstract syntax tree nodes into concrete Python values and collection bindings.

`MutableSchemaShape` is the state orchestrator for the migration replay pipeline — it consumes frozen `SchemaShape` objects to produce a mutable working environment that supports O(1) schema mutations and phantom object resolution.

`recognizers.py` is the AST pattern-matching engine for the migration replay pipeline — it consumes `ast.Call` nodes to identify and extract semantic DDL operations (collections, indices, graphs) from migration scripts.

`head_calibration_audit.py` is the diagnostic analyzer for the model head calibration and standard deviation gating pipeline — it consumes raw segment statistics and calibration state from ArangoDB to produce a distribution audit, gate simulation, and calibration efficacy report.
`walker.py` is the orchestrator for the migration replay engine — it sequences AST traversal, context binding, recursive helper resolution, and DDL mutation to reconstruct the database schema state.
`scripts/diagnostics/agent_dashboard/__main__.py` is the CLI entry point for the agent diagnostic dashboard, orchestrating the discovery, parsing, and serialization of Copilot debug logs.

`dashboard.js` is the client-side orchestrator for the agent performance diagnostics dashboard — it consumes JSON diagnostic reports to render interactive charts, sortable efficiency tables, and hierarchical session trees.

`config.py` is the configuration orchestrator and environment bootstrap for the embedding research pipeline — it defines model registries, path resolution, and audio stratification logic for the `nomarr` research suite.

`serializer.py` is the transformer and persistence layer for the agent dashboard — it maps complex `Session` and `AgentInvocation` object graphs into a flattened, JSON-serializable schema for static web consumption.

`models.py` is the data schema and aggregation engine for the agent diagnostics dashboard — it defines the core telemetry structures (`LLMCall`, `ToolCall`, `AgentInvocation`, `Session`) and provides the analytical logic to compute performance aggregates and tool usage profiles.
`parser.py` is the parser for the agent dashboard diagnostics pipeline — it consumes JSONL debug logs from VS Code Copilot to reconstruct hierarchical agent invocation trees and session metadata.

`classify.py` is the orchestrator for the embedding-research inference pipeline — it sequences the execution of ONNX-based head models, manages filesystem-based caching of activations, and performs comparative metric analysis between flat and binned classification workflows.

`similarity.py` is the analytical orchestrator for the embedding retrieval pipeline — it sequences vector similarity computation, approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) indexing, and multi-dimensional retrieval quality assessment.

`binned_ptc.py` is the persistence layer for the PTC-derived binned embedding pipeline — it manages the filesystem serialization, indexing, and retrieval of multi-strategy vector pools and head activations.

`run.py` is the orchestrator and CLI entry point for the embedding research pipeline — it sequences the six-phase execution (ingest, embed, segment, classify, analyze, report), manages the lifecycle of ONNX model sessions, and handles state persistence via DuckDB.

`scripts/embedding_research/db/binned.py` is the persistence layer for the binned-embedding research pipeline — it orchestrates the storage and retrieval of calibration data, classification metrics, and song-level statistical analysis.

`binning.py` is the algorithmic library and configuration orchestrator for the temporal segmentation pipeline — it provides the core logic for partitioning embedding sequences into coherent bins and standardizes the configuration constants used across the research suite.

`scripts/embedding_research/report/__init__.py` is the orchestrator for the embedding research reporting pipeline — it sequences data extraction from DuckDB, dispatches modular section generation, and serializes the final results into a self-contained HTML/JSON report.

`queries.py` is the persistence layer adapter for the embedding research pipeline — it provides a unified interface to query both DuckDB relational tables and filesystem-based caches for completed work units.

`_base.py` is the factory and formatter for the embedding research reporting pipeline — it orchestrates the generation of JSON-serializable descriptors for Plotly charts, tables, and hierarchical report sections.

`scripts/embedding_research/report/_binned.py` is the report generator for binned analysis — it consumes processed embedding dataframes and SQL connections to produce structured, visual sections for threshold sweeps, segment diversity, and bin-mode comparisons.

`scripts/embedding_research/db/_schema.py` is the persistence layer and schema orchestrator for the embedding research pipeline — it defines the DuckDB relational structure, manages connection lifecycles, and enforces DDL consistency across the research environment.

`_heads.py` is the report generator for head-specific attention analysis — it consumes database metrics to produce visualization sections for Spearman correlation heatmaps and CTP/PTC value comparisons.

`scripts/embedding_research/report/_retrieval.py` is the data-processing orchestrator for the retrieval evaluation pipeline — it consumes raw metrics from DuckDB to produce structured report sections, including unified ranking tables, per-backbone scatter plots, and delta-based performance visualizations.

`scripts/embedding_research/strategy_binned/_process.py` is the analytical orchestrator for the binned embedding research pipeline — it consumes `UnitTensor` collections to compute aggregated similarity matrices and derives retrieval performance metrics for downstream evaluation.

`segment_fn.py` is the adapter for the CTP (Classifier-based Temporal Pooling) pipeline — it orchestrates the transformation of patch embeddings into segmented, pooled vector streams by bridging ONNX inference sessions with temporal binning logic.

`segment_fn.py` is the factory for the PTC (Patch Temporal Clustering) segmentation pipeline — it produces a closure that orchestrates calibration-aware temporal binning, vector pooling, and persistence for patch matrices.

`find_same_layer_redirections.py` is the static analyzer for the Nomarr codebase that identifies redundant redirection wrappers by parsing ASTs to detect single-statement passthrough calls within the same architectural layer.
`compare_mood_tags.py` is the verification utility and consistency analyzer that reconciles on-disk audio metadata (essentia-tensorflow era) against the authoritative ArangoDB (ONNX era) state.

`patch_musicnn_conv.py` is the model transformer for the ONNX inference pipeline — it performs structural graph surgery to replace problematic `Conv` nodes with `MatMul` decompositions to bypass hardware-specific cuDNN failures.

`tests/unit/aql_safety/conftest.py` is the static analysis orchestrator for the AQL safety validation suite — it sequences AST traversal, regex-based pattern matching, and query resolution to enforce database integrity constraints across the codebase.
